name: Word pills
what: Words in outlined pills fall from the top one after another, land with a bounce and a tilt, and pile up; at the end the pile drops away.

learned_from.what: the pills falling and piling across the frame (~41 f at 25 fps)
the drop into a loose cluster

motion: a pill every 4 f, falls 16 f (accelerating), bounces 10 f; the pile drops 14-20 f
